sample_data.method: Bundled default data, case selection, and JSON file upload through the same validation/calculation path
sample_data.reset_instructions: Select Reset sample in the top bar to restore all 25 published cases and PUB-01.

problem_solving_method: A decimal-safe pure tariff engine allocates each day across calendar-month slabs, reconstructs the ledger, and is reused by forecasting, target-date advice, and deterministic habit comparison. The interface exposes traces and reconciliation instead of hiding calculations.

R1.evidence: Six-month signal map and monthly profile in components/meter-advisor.tsx; fixture upload in src/data/fixture.ts; official data in public/data/P10_prepaid_meter_public.json

R2.evidence: Balance chart and inspectable ledger in components/balance-chart.tsx and components/meter-advisor.tsx; calculation engine in src/domain/ledger.ts and src/domain/tariff.ts

R3.evidence: Interactive forecast and target-date breakdown in components/meter-advisor.tsx backed by src/domain/advice.ts and src/domain/advice.test.ts

R4.evidence: Cost/deposit comparison and invariant explanation in components/meter-advisor.tsx; src/domain/comparison.ts; all-case invariants in src/data/fixture.test.ts

team_members.major_contribution: Sole participant: architecture, tariff and ledger engine, fixture support, automated testing, application interface, visual verification and documentation.

major_design_decisions: Represent money as integer poisha and split units across all crossed slabs.
Use start-of-day recharge and fixed charges before that day's consumption, matching the clarification's habit ordering.
Reuse one pure tariff/ledger engine across all four requirements.
Keep consumed cost separate from deposits and make energy/VAT equality an explicit tested invariant.
Provide judge-supplied JSON upload, all-case selection, and reset without a backend.
known_limitations: Uploaded fixture state is not persisted across page refreshes.
The published whole-unit reading schema is enforced; fractional units are rejected.
VAT is rounded per daily energy charge to the nearest poisha because no alternative rounding interval is specified.
Deployment is pending, so live_url is currently blank.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Implementation assistance, test generation, interface composition and documentation.
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Participant review, hand-calculated boundary tests, 39 automated tests including all 25 fixtures, TypeScript and ESLint checks, production build, and Chromium desktop/mobile visual QA.
